name: financetracker
description: Personal finance tracker: Cloudflare Worker + D1, a PWA, and a Telegram bot

scripts.dev:seed: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply financetracker --local && npx wrangler d1 execute financetracker --local --file=./seed.sql
scripts.migrate: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply financetracker --remote
scripts.migrate:local: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply financetracker --local
scripts.tail:staging: cd worker && npx wrangler tail --env staging
scripts.seed:staging: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 execute financetracker-staging --env staging --remote --file=./seed.sql
